sourceText:
Jalapeno Chicken Wings
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 11, 2009 - 11:59pm

Ingredients




12 ounces chili sauce
1/2 cup vinegar
1/2 cup vegetable oil
1/2 cup dark brown sugar
1/4 cup ketchup
1/2 med. onion, sliced
4 jalapeno peppers, seeded
2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce
2 teaspoons salt
5 lbs. chicken wings

Preparation

1 Blend all ingredients (except wings) in a blender. Set this aside. 2 Remove the bony tips from the chicken wings and cut the remainder in half at the joint. 3 Put these pieces in a roasting pan and cover with half the sauce. Cook at 325 degrees for 30 minutes. Then turn the wings over and cover them with the remainder of the sauce. Bake 30 more minutes. Serve wings warm or at room temperature. Serves 6 to 8.
